$comment: Feature map settings for this repo. Every key is optional. repo_url is the prefix for plan links (a GitHub blob URL ends in the branch: .../blob/main/). Phases: the timeline columns, in order; done plans always sit under 'now'. A phase with gate: true is a planning pause. plan_fields: the frontmatter keys that hold a plan's tracker and roadmap row URLs. external: plans that live outside the repo (a wiki, Notion, Confluence) listed in external-plans.json; drop it if every plan is a repo file. tracker: the issue tracker whose rows tracker-snapshot.json copies; id_pattern pulls a row id out of a row URL (one capture group); drop it if you have no tracker. owner_label: the person whose steps gate work, as the Work view names them ("Waits on <owner_label>"). branches: where work lands (integration) and where it is promoted (release, or null when nothing is promoted); the Work view's delivery numbers use them.
